help.target: Shows range, concentration and outliers of the target.
help.intensity: Reveals exposure, contrast and saturation of images.
help.channels: Compares mean and variation per channel.
help.features: Inspects the shape and scale of each variable.
help.summary: Compares center and dispersion across variables.
help.correlation: Detects redundant or strongly related variables.
help.series: Shows the average temporal pattern per variable.
help.lengths: Helps choose padding and maximum length.
help.tokens: Reveals dominant vocabulary and possible artifacts.
help.coverage: Measures how much foreground each mask occupies.
